transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is... my shoulders and neck. They just stay clenched up all day. It's, uh, kind of like I'm bracing for a classroom observation that never ends. And by the evening... my jaw aches so badly I can't really even enjoy playing my guitar. So... I'm just here to see about that.
How long have you been experiencing this clenching in your shoulders and neck?
Um... I guess it's been about a year and two months. That's, uh... that's when I was fired from the preschool. So... since then, I suppose.
Is the pain in your shoulders, neck, and jaw the main thing that's been bothering you?
Um... yeah, I suppose so. It's... it's just the most obvious thing. The aching, I mean. So... yes. That's mainly it.
Is the pain in your shoulders, neck, and jaw present all the time?
Um... pretty much, yeah. It's... it's just kind of always there. Maybe a little worse by the end of the day, but... yeah, mostly all the time.
Do you think the tension in your shoulders, neck, and jaw is related to feeling anxious or stressed?

Um... I guess... maybe. I just know it's... well, it's what finally pushed me to come in. My shoulders and neck just stay clenched all day. It feels like... I don't know, like I'm bracing for a classroom observation that never ends. And... by the evening, my jaw aches so badly I can hardly even enjoy playing my guitar. So... maybe it's stress. I don't know.
You mentioned being fired from the preschool, is that event still causing you significant distress?
Um... no, not really. I mean... it happened a while ago. So... no. I wouldn't say that.
Are your shoulder, neck, and jaw symptoms interfering with your daily routine or activities?

Um... I guess so. The tension makes it hard to focus. I've... I've missed some application deadlines for new jobs. And when I do get interviews, I just kind of... stumble through them. I used to volunteer for story-time at the library, but... I stopped doing that unless someone else handles all the planning. So... yeah, I guess it's keeping me from getting back into the classroom.
Do you find yourself worrying about things even when there's no apparent reason to worry?

Um... I suppose so. Yeah. It just... my mind doesn't really stop. I just keep circling back to things. Like... whether I'll ever get hired again, or... if I've somehow ruined my reputation with the parents from before. And then... I start thinking about retirement, and how that feels like it's just slipping away. Even... I don't know, even small things. Like if I make a minor mistake during a story-time activity, I start thinking... maybe I shouldn't be trusted with children anymore. It's just... a lot of circling.
Do you think your worries are worse than what most people would worry about in the same situations?
Um... I don't know. Maybe. I mean... I guess everyone worries about their job and their future. I just... I don't really know how much other people worry about it. It just feels like a lot to me.
Do you often find yourself worrying about everyday things, like finances or relationships, even when they're going well?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really noticed that. Things haven't exactly been going well lately, so... I don't really know if I do that or not.
Do you feel like you can control your worrying when it starts?

Um... no. Not really. I try to. I tell myself to just... make a list, or pray, or maybe go weed the garden. Just try to focus on the next practical step. But... it doesn't really work. One worry just sort of... hands off to another. And then... I don't know, I realize I've lost half the afternoon to it. So... no.
Do you think your worries about things like your job and reputation are disproportionate to how most people would react in the same situation?

Um... I don't know. I think... I mean, I can't really speak for how other people would react. I don't really talk to anyone else about it, so... I'm not sure if it's out of proportion or not. I just couldn't say.
Have your worries been affecting your relationships with friends or family?

Um... I don't really know. I haven't exactly noticed it causing any issues, if that's what you mean. I mostly just... keep to myself anyway. I try not to bother my family with, um, with what's going on in my head. So... I don't think so.
Have you avoided any social activities or gatherings because of your worries?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really go to a lot of social things to begin with, so... it hasn't really come up. I just go to work and come home, mostly. So... no.
Have you noticed that your worrying is affecting your ability to perform daily tasks or achieve your goals?

Um... I suppose it is. I mean... I've missed some application deadlines. And... the interviews I have had, I just kind of stumble through them. I don't know. I even stopped volunteering for story-time... well, unless someone else handles all the planning. It's just... the worrying is keeping me from getting back into the classroom in any reliable way. So... yeah. I guess it is.
Do you feel like your worrying is making it hard for you to enjoy things you used to like or be around people you care about?

Um... not really. I mean... I still like the things I usually do. Mostly just... quiet things at home. And I already mentioned I kind of keep to myself anyway, so... it's not that I can't be around people. I just... I don't think it's affecting that.
Do you think the tension in your shoulders, neck, and jaw would go away if you weren't worried about things?
Um... I don't know. I guess... maybe? I haven't really thought about it like that. It's just... always there, so I'm not sure what it would feel like without it.
Do you feel like your worrying is causing you a lot of emotional pain or distress?
Um... I guess so. It's... it's just hard. I don't really know how to describe it, but... yeah, it's pretty overwhelming sometimes. Just... constantly thinking about everything.
Do you think you would still worry about things even if all the problems in your life were solved?
Um... I don't really know. I mean... I've never really had a time where absolutely everything was solved, so... it's hard to say. I guess I'm just not sure.
Do you worry about things even when everything in your life is going well?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... it's hard to remember a time when there wasn't at least something going on. So... I don't really know.
